text: Labelling every vertex real network unreadable, labels sit markers vanish edges worse. mark_node_text() four tools : top_n / label important vertices (e.g. highest-degree hubs) – common “label handful, 34” move one-liner. dist pushes label radially outward layout centre, clears node marker. repel = TRUE nudges labels still overlap apart, ggrepel-style, thin leader line back vertex. effects = list(shadow()) drops shadow behind label stays legible crosses edge. mark_edge_text() takes effects.
code: vgraph(g, layout = "stress") |>   mark_edges(alpha = 0.3) |>   mark_nodes(size = deg, fill = grp) |>   mark_node_text(     label = name,     top_n = 8,     by = deg,     dist = 3,     color = "white",     effects = list(shadow(x = 0.4, y = -0.4))   ) |>   scale_size(range = c(0.5, 3))

title: Spatial and networks
text: Edges straight default. routing = "elbow" draws orthogonal right-angle steps instead – still straight segments (curved edges deliberate non-goal), stepping along whichever axis endpoints farther apart , top-tree bends downward. natural routing "tree", "sugiyama", dendrogram layouts, keeps node-boundary caps arrowheads.  directed graphs, gradient = TRUE fades edge faint source opaque target – direction cue reads without arrowheads (without clutter add dense graph).
code: tr <- igraph::make_tree(15, children = 2, mode = "out") vgraph(tr, layout = "tree") |>   mark_edges(routing = "elbow", arrow = TRUE) |>   mark_nodes(size = 2, fill = "steelblue") dg <- igraph::sample_gnp(15, 0.2, directed = TRUE) vgraph(dg) |>   mark_edges(gradient = TRUE) |>   mark_nodes(size = 2, fill = "grey30")

title: Spatial and networks
text: dense graph, straight edges pile unreadable hairball. mark_edge_bundle() routes bundled curves instead, edges run roughly together merge trunks backbone graph shows . drop-swap mark_edges() – edge aesthetics apply – delegates geometry edgebundle package. type picks algorithm; bundled edges faint default overlapping trunks read density.  algorithms trade speed aggressively merge: "force" (default, force-directed) "path" bend edges gently, "stub" tufts endpoint, "mingle" merges hierarchically. directed graph, type = "divided" splits trunk direction. Pass algorithm-specific tuning params, e.g. params = list(compatibility_threshold = 0.5).
code: gb <- igraph::sample_gnp(60, 0.08) vgraph(gb, layout = "stress") |>   mark_edge_bundle(type = "hammer", color = "firebrick") |>   mark_nodes(size = 1.5, fill = "grey20")

title: Spatial and networks
text: flow map shows one source fanning many destinations, branches merging trunks whose width grows combined flow – shape Minard used Napoleon’s march cartographers use migration. Give mark_flow_map() one--many (star) graph laid fixed coordinates, name root, map per-edge flow weight.  type = "spiral" (default) recommended layout: planar, angle-restricted spiral tree needs edgebundle package. type = "steiner" builds approximate Steiner tree instead (additionally needs package). computed flow mapped onto width_range, widest trunk near root stays legible however lopsided weights .
code: set.seed(1) dest <- 10 fg <- igraph::make_star(dest + 1, mode = "undirected") igraph::V(fg)$name <- c("hub", paste0("d", seq_len(dest))) igraph::E(fg)$weight <- sample(1:20, dest, replace = TRUE) coords <- rbind(   c(0, 0),   cbind(runif(dest, 1, 6), runif(dest, -3, 3)) )  vgraph(fg, layout = coords) |>   mark_flow_map(root = "hub", weight = weight) |>   mark_nodes(size = 1.5, fill = "grey30")

text: vgraph() also accepts base hclust/dendrogram, coercing tree carries merge’s height. "dendrogram" layout places leaves line every merge height, elbow_at = "start" turns elbow classic bracket (siblings share bar parent’s level):  Add labels mark_text(), controls angle justification – top-tree leaf labels read vertically, hanging leaves (merge nodes carry blank label, leaves show):  vdendrogram() one-line preset – bracket edges placed leaf labels, direction orient , k cut tree colour clusters (branches cut stay neutral):  unrooted trees (phylogeny-style), layout = "unrooted" uses graphlayouts’ layout_as_tree_unrooted() – mode picks "equalangle", "equaldaylight", "stress":

title: Spatial and networks
text: Vertex metrics analyst’s choice, something vgraph() computes behind back – augment attaches set request, can map filter without manual igraph round-trip. augment = TRUE adds degree components; character vector picks degree, betweenness, closeness, eigen, coreness, components, community, /-degree variants. filter_nodes / filter_edges take data-masked predicates vertex / edge attributes, k_core keeps k-core. Filtering happens layout, see clean layout subgraph rather full layout holes – honest way tame dense graph (node-link idiom breaks past link density ~3).
code: # attach degree + community, then plot just the 2-core, sized and coloured by them vgraph(g, augment = c("degree", "community"), k_core = 2) |>   mark_edges(alpha = 0.3) |>   mark_nodes(size = degree, fill = factor(community)) |>   mark_node_text(label = name, top_n = 6, by = degree, dist = 3) |>   scale_size(range = c(0.5, 3))

title: Statistical marks
text: scatter shows joint distribution two variables hides one . add_marginal() puts back: draws distribution x along top edge y along right edge, scale panel lines points. vellumplot counterpart ggExtra::ggMarginal().  Unlike marks article, add_marginal() plot modifier rather layer, closer facet_wrap() mark_density(). takes encoding ; reads x y first plain layer (mark_point()) computes margins . type = "histogram" bins values instead smoothing , sides picks edges draw.  scatter maps discrete color fill, group = TRUE splits margin way, per-group density sits points matching colour. scatter’s legend already names groups, none added.  Margins share panel’s scales reserve space around single panel, version combine facets, flipped polar coordinate system, fixed aspect ratio.

code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, color = "grey60") |>   mark_summary(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fun = median)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_smooth() fits model y x (per group) draws fitted line confidence ribbon se = TRUE. layers naturally raw points.  method chooses fit: "lm" (linear), "loess" (local regression, span controlling neighbourhood), "glm" (family via method.args, e.g. logistic), "gam" (penalised smooth, needs ), "rq" (quantile regression, needs ). default "auto" picks loess small groups gam large ones.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg, se = TRUE, level = 0.95) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg, method = "loess", span = 0.9)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_ellipse() mark_hull() enclose set points single region — way read group separation scatter without drawing every point’s membership. color fill mapped, group gets region. mark_ellipse() draws covariance ellipse (robust t distribution default, "norm" / "euclid"), following ggplot2’s stat_ellipse():  mark_hull() draws convex hull instead. unfilled boundaries default (matching ggplot2); map set fill shade :
code: vplot(iris) |>   mark_point(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) |>   mark_ellipse(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) vplot(iris) |>   mark_point(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) |>   mark_hull(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, fill = Species, alpha = 0.2)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_line(window = ) transforms line’s y drawing — rolling statistic, running total, lag/lead — computed per group rows ordered x. Pass op name list(op, k, ...). 7-point trailing mean rides raw series:  ops cover rolling mean/sum/median/min/max (k, align, partial), running cumsum/cummean/cummax/cummin, lag/lead, rank.
code: set.seed(1) ts <- data.frame(day = 1:120, value = cumsum(rnorm(120))) vplot(ts) |>   mark_line(x = day, y = value, color = "grey70") |>   mark_line(x = day, y = value, window = list(op = "mean", k = 7))

title: Statistical marks
text: Several marks summarise single variable distributed. mark_ecdf() draws empirical cumulative distribution x step, scale-free way compare groups without choosing bandwidth.  mark_qq() plots sorted sample quantiles reference distribution (normal default); mark_qq_line() adds reference line quartiles. Points line mean sample matches reference.  mark_rug() adds marginal ticks observation, compact companion scatter density. sides picks edges ("b", "l", "t", "r").
code: vplot(penguins) |>   mark_ecdf(x = bill_len, color = species) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_qq(sample = mpg) |>   mark_qq_line(sample = mpg) vplot(faithful) |>   mark_point(x = waiting, y = eruptions) |>   mark_rug()

text: mark_violin() draws mirrored kernel density y categorical x, boxplot’s silhouette shows full shape group.  mark_ridgeline() turns side: density x per categorical y, ridges overlapping many groups fit little vertical space. Use height argument tune much overlap.  mark_dotplot() bins x stacks one dot per observation, height stack count can read dot dot.

Set interval probabilities .width.
code: set.seed(1) draws <- data.frame(   model = rep(c("prior", "posterior", "pooled"), each = 800),   estimate = rnorm(2400, rep(c(0, 1.5, 1), each = 800), rep(c(1, 0.5, 0.7), each = 800)) ) vplot(draws) |>   mark_halfeye(x = model, y = estimate, .width = c(0.66, 0.95))

Layer effects (glow(), outline(), shadow()) gradient fills (linear_gradient(), radial_gradient()). text: mark_smooth() supports several methods: "auto" (default) picks "loess" small groups (< 1000 points) "gam" large ones. "lm" / "glm" — linear generalised linear fits (glm takes family via method.args, e.g. binomial() logistic). "loess" — local regression, controlled span. title: vellumplot 0.6.0
text: Sankey styling options. vsankey() / mark_sankey() gain show_values (append node’s value label), flow_color ("source", "target", "gradient" — source--target colour fade per ribbon), node_width / node_gap tune node rectangles. Sunburst / radial hierarchies: vsunburst(). new plot type part--whole hierarchies, parent list — id, parent (NA root), value (leaf values; internal nodes sum children). Label repulsion: mark_text(repel = TRUE) / mark_label(repel = TRUE). Overlapping text labels moved apart force-directed layout (ggrepel-style), keeping thin leader line back point. plot size fixed spec, repulsion resolved exactly true rendered panel — two-pass compile reads panel’s device geometry vellum::scene_model(), relaxes label boxes pixel space, maps result back — needs approximation vellum change, deterministic seed. Tunable via box_padding, point_padding, min_segment_length, seed. Limited single cartesian panel now (facets / composition / polar error clearly). mark_line(window = ): rolling / cumulative / offset transforms. line can now transform y per group (rows ordered x) drawing — moving mean/sum/median/min/max window k, running cumsum/cummean/cummax/cummin, lag/lead shifts, rank. Pass op name (window = "mean") list (window = list(op = "mean", k = 7, align = "right", partial = TRUE)); align trailing/leading/centred partial fills edges shorter window line stays continuous. plot without window unchanged. Diverging colour scales: scale_color_gradient2() / scale_fill_gradient2(). three-point ramp (low–mid–high) centred midpoint (default 0), rescaled midpoint (scales::rescale_mid) neutral colour sits chosen value side spans far data reaches — correct scale signed / anomaly data. diverging continuous colorbar also reports midpoint + diverging colorbar descriptor, interactive host can centre value-range filter neutral value. symlog position transform. scale_x_continuous(trans = "symlog") (y) adds symmetric-log axis: linear zero, logarithmic tails (sign(x) · log10(1 + |x|)), signed data spanning several orders magnitude — including zero negatives, log10 show — reads one axis. Breaks sit zero signed powers ten. transform name flows panel scales descriptor like transforms. New formula, span, method.args arguments; glm/gam bands use normal interval, lm/loess t-interval. Previously mark_smooth() errored method "lm".   Suggests — gated method errors clearly package absent. Data panels emitted pannable, gridlines tagged. Position adjustments (position =): grouped bars stack default; "dodge" places side side "fill" normalises group 1. mark_point(position = "jitter") spreads overlapping points. Datashading: mark_datashade() aggregates large point cloud density raster (via vellum::datashade()) fills panel — cost independent point count. mark_point(auto = TRUE) switches automatically ~50k rows. marks: areas/ribbons (mark_area(), mark_ribbon()), steps (mark_step()), intervals (mark_errorbar(), mark_linerange(), mark_segment()), mark_boxplot(), tiles/heatmaps (mark_tile(), mark_raster()), 2-D binning (mark_bin2d(), mark_hex()), mark_text() / mark_label(), pie/donut shortcuts (mark_pie(), mark_donut()). statistical transforms: mark_density() (kernel density), mark_summary() (aggregate y per category), addition histogram / binning / smooth stats. Map computed variables after_stat(). Coordinate systems: coord_cartesian() (view-window zoom), coord_flip(), coord_fixed() / coord_equal() (aspect lock), coord_polar() (pie / coxcomb / radar). Themes: theme_gray() (default), theme_minimal(), theme_bw(), theme_classic(), theme_void(), theme() ad-hoc overrides (panel background, gridlines, text, strip background, legend position, margins). Effects & paints: stroked point marks take layer effects = list(...) argument — glow() (neon halo), outline() (contrasting halo legibility), shadow() (drop / ambient). linear_gradient() / radial_gradient() can used fill value (area / ribbon / bar), theme_cyberpunk() ties glow + gradients + neon palette mplcyberpunk look. Hand-drawn (“sketch”) rendering: sketch() (re-exported vellum) gives geometry mark wobbly, hachure-filled Rough.js look via sketch = argument. Unlike layer effect geometry property, generated natively engine, exact, cross-backend, works PDF. rides three levels, -specific-wins: mark’s sketch =, element_line() / element_rect() sketch = slot, plot-wide theme_sketch() one-liner (hand-drawn gridlines, axes, ticks, marks legend keys paper background). sketch = NA forces element crisp; text never sketched (pair handwriting font). Composition: hconcat(), vconcat(), concat(), wrap_plots() arrange several plots grid; aligned path lines panel edges can collect guides across sub-plots. inset() overlays plot, compose_annotation() adds figure-level titles auto-tags (, B, …). Repeat: repeat_() replicates plot across set fields, zipping one encodings produce composition. Blend modes: marks take blend = argument (CSS mix-blend-mode set — "multiply", "screen", "darken", …). layer composites one isolated group panel earlier layers, e.g. two overlapping translucent layers "multiply". Spatial: mark_sf() draws geometry column sf object map layer (polygons / lines / points), coord_sf() reproject target CRS lock map aspect ratio; scale_fill_binned() / scale_color_binned() bin continuous fill/colour discrete classes choropleths. Network: vgraph() starts node-link diagram igraph graph — runs layout (stress majorization default, via graphlayouts; "sparse_stress", "backbone", "fr", "circle", … matrix/function), builds node edge table, locks aspect void theme. mark_edges() draws edges (straight, batched; reciprocal/parallel edges offset centre line, self-loops nested, optional arrow), mark_nodes() vertices, mark_node_text() labels — fixed edges--nodes draw order. Edges capped exactly endpoint’s node boundary (per vertex, resolution), arrowheads land node edge. scale_edge_width() maps weight edge width legend. igraph / graphlayouts optional (Suggests). Output: render_plot(plot, path); vellum::render(plot, path) print(plot) also work. compiler registered vellum’s as_vellum_scene() seam.
